added 1 commit
  • 61d9b650 - ieee802.11: Start adding support for 802.11be.
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/4984/diffs?diff_id=274213468&start_sha=0e8a9a90389ad6008dfa43f930aa7ce16584125e)

The problem is that the HE variant of the HT Control field defines that as a list where each element in the list consists of a 4-bit Control ID followed by some variable number of bits.

See, for example, 9.2.4.3a HE Variant in Draft P802.11ax_D8.0 and earlier. The search term would be HE Variant or Control ID (because the section numbers shift around a bit.)

So, that means the bits are not in the same place. I have opted to shift the bits of interest for each type down to the bottom of the word etc.

It's the craziest approach to serializing the fields I have ever seen.
A small comment but it is good to me
